info.title: API.SH: Project Gutenberg
info.description: The Project Gutenberg API from API.SH: public Project Gutenberg data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every book by one author (or with them as translator, editor or illustrator), sorted by popularity, release date or title, with the author's name and Wikipedia links. 25 books per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gutenberg-author

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Author id (from /gutenberg/v1/authors or a book's authors), or a gutenberg.org/ebooks/author link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: `downloads` (most downloaded first, default), `release_date` (newest first) or `title`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gutenberg-authors

get.description:
Every book on one bookshelf (the site's main categories such as Adventure or Poetry, and the volunteers' hand-picked reading lists), sorted by popularity, release date, title or author. 25 books per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gutenberg-bookshelf

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Bookshelf id (from /gutenberg/v1/bookshelves), or a gutenberg.org/ebooks/bookshelf link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The whole bookshelf index: the main categories (grouped, e.g. Literature, History, Science) and every reading list, each with its id. With `q`, finds bookshelves by name instead, with their downloads (paged with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gutenberg-bookshelves

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Project Gutenberg catalogue of free public-domain ebooks by keywords, author, title, subject and language, sorted by popularity, release date or title. Each book has its ebook number, title, author, downloads in the last 30 days (or its release date when sorted by release date) and cover image links. With no criteria at all it lists the whole catalogue (newest first with `sort=release_date`). 25 books per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gutenberg-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords matched against titles, authors and subjects.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author name words, e.g. `austen` or `mark twain`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: `downloads` (most downloaded first, default), `release_date` (newest first) or `title`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
